package.description: A free, reduced-functionality version of our LabChart data acquisition and analysis software.

en-US.description: A free, reduced-functionality version of our LabChart data acquisition and analysis software.
en-US.longDescription:
LabChart Reader is a free, reduced functionality version of our LabChart data acquisition and analysis software.

With LabChart Reader you can:
- Open LabChart data files
- Import other file formats
- View and scroll through data
- Set up and modify calculations and analysis settings
- Install the Spirometry and Cardiac Axis Extensions
- Analyze data
- Print

LabChart Reader cannot:
- Record new data
- Save data
- Use other analysis modules and extensions
- Send and Publish

For details of the full version of LabChart and our PowerLab data acquisition hardware systems, please see our website at www.adinstruments.com.
en-US.name: ADInstruments LabChart Reader

zh-CN.description: LabChart 数据采集和分析软件的免费精简版。
zh-CN.longDescription:
LabChart Reader 是我们 LabChart 数据采集与分析软件的免费精简版。

使用 LabChart Reader 您可以：
- 打开 LabChart 数据文件
- 导入其他文件格式
- 查看和滚动浏览数据
- 设置和修改计算及分析参数
- 安装肺活量和心电轴扩展模块
- 分析数据
- 打印

LabChart Reader 无法实现：
- 记录新数据
- 保存数据
- 使用其他分析模块和扩展功能
- 发送和发布数据

如需了解 LabChart 完整版及 PowerLab 数据采集硬件系统的详细信息，请访问我们的官方网站：www.adinstruments.com。
